confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on Penang-specific Numbeo entries cross-checked against George Town figures and aggregator summaries. Sources are sample-based, mixed-date and not specifically July 2026, so treat them as ballpark. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught; Numbeo's George Town (RM10) and Penang (RM17) draught figures disagree. Cocktail (about 2.2x beer) and wine_glass (about 1.7x beer) rest mainly on the local beer relationship, which is the disclosed basis: cocktail direct evidence was scattered RM30-50 bar figures, and wine direct evidence was one undated house-wine price of RM21. Ringgit values use an assumed working rate of about 4.2 MYR per USD from general knowledge, not a live quote; a travel site's 4.7 may be outdated, and at that level food USD values would be about 10-12% too high. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation searches were run and no booking pages or listings were checked. FX is the latest RBA observation found (18 Nov 2026); no 19 Nov reading was located.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang-specific basis: Numbeo entries for Penang and George Town (the island's main city) plus aggregator summaries for food and drink; no separate comparable city was used. Accommodation is a general-knowledge comparison with budget and mid-range hostels and hotels in George Town, Penang.
